toneModel.historicalEvidence: Both printed 1961 restored Palm first-verses have five flattened terminal pitch groups; generic 1f office source shares the f termination. Same terminal pitch family does not itself guarantee all GABC underlays or distinct first-half mediants.
toneModel.normalizedDoxology: Gloria Patri and Sicut erat sung as final psalm doxology (two verse-length members), then the same associated antiphon is repeated.
toneModel.euouae: E-u-o-u-a-e mnemonic for the six syllables of sæculorum Amen, used to specify psalm termination/differentia; not a separately sung lyric or automatically a literal melodic map for this Palm witness.
